# Codex Review

Target: branch diff against main

The new CI validation has false-green paths for missing article schemas and canonicals pointing to the wrong origin. These gaps undermine the SEO regressions the patch is intended to gate.

Full review comments:

- [P2] Require expected schema types on schema-bearing routes — /Users/cm10/pickle-hub-pro/tests/seo.spec.ts:163-164
  If the fixed blog route or sampled blog/news pages stop emitting their article schema—or replace it with another valid JSON-LD type—`assertJsonLd` finds nothing requiring validation and this call ignores the returned zero/count. The tests therefore pass without any `BlogPosting`/`NewsArticle`, bypassing the advertised required-field gate; add route- or segment-specific expected types while retaining the explicit schema-free club exception.

- [P2] Validate the canonical production origin — /Users/cm10/pickle-hub-pro/tests/seo.spec.ts:157-160
  When `CANONICAL_HOST` is misconfigured to a preview or typo domain, both sitemap and SSR URLs use that wrong host, but the sitemap URLs are re-homed and canonical assertions compare only `pathname`, so the entire gate remains green. Since canonical host controls which origin is indexed, assert the expected production `origin` in addition to the path here and in the sitemap sweep.
